media.title: Hermann Biek (Ben Berlin; also Bick) — portrait
media.description: Portrait of Hermann Biek, Kaper’s Berlin-era piano-duo partner.
media.altText: Portrait of the pianist Hermann Biek.
media.rightsNote: The collectors’ site grammophon-platten.de identifies Hermann Biek but supplies no photographer, date, original publication, or reusable licence for the portrait. Its copyright status remains undetermined and the local copy is confined to the person record.
media.publicCaption: Hermann Biek, Kaper’s Berlin-era piano-duo partner, who was professionally known as Ben Berlin and credited with Kaper as Hermann Bick.
media.publicCreditLine: grammophon-platten.de, “Hermann Biek / Ben Berlin”; low-resolution portrait used for scholarly identification and commentary.
